label: Synthetic. Written by hand from the provider's public API documentation for WO-E-CON-1; never captured from a provider. No provider was called and no account or token was used. Ids, names, paths, cursors and tokens are invented. Pins a response shape, not provider behaviour the page does not state. retrievedAt is the UTC clock read immediately after the documentation fetch (an upper bound).
scenario: A drive's delta token the service can no longer serve, answered with the second resync code of the delta page's table (resyncChangesUploadDifferences). The Location header is recorded and must never be followed.
assumes: The code sits in error.code of Graph's standard error body; the page read does not show the 410 body itself.
